notes.sowing: Sow outdoors {cm:1.5} deep 1 to 4 weeks after your last frost, once the soil is at least {c:18}. For an earlier start, sow indoors in individual pots 3 to 4 weeks before planting out, and plant out without disturbing the roots.
notes.care: Train vines up a trellis about {cm:120} tall to save space and keep fruit clean. Water about {cm:2.5} a week, evenly and at the base of the plant. Mulch once the soil is warm.
notes.harvest: Pick slicers at {cm:20} to {cm:25} and picklers smaller, before the seeds swell and the skin yellows. Pick every day or two: fruit left on the vine slows new fruit.
